claims.statement: The fixture typechecks clean on its own under tsc 7.0.2 with zero diagnostics; a contract-violating caller is the negative control.

Two minimalist competing method vocabularies were built and compared as executable probes (v1-verbs, v2-predicates) with a deterministic comparison harness; the review round found them TIED on three of four criteria, so neither is selected.

Arm C meets its prompt-derived acceptance checklist: 3/3 cross-checks pass, including that every TESTED numeric claim in the note is present in the evidence JSON and that all nine run artifacts exist and are non-empty.
Blind-discovery exclusions (other arms, the legacy alignment map) are disclosed in the run note rather than silently relied upon.
The three-operation vocabulary exists/witnessed/enforced is a live contender but NOT frozen: n=1 fixture cannot adjudicate it, and WikiCore remains a working name, not an approved protocol.
Whether the recovered 17-family symbolic lexer is a better intake than the probes built here was not tested by this run.

publication.reason: Run note, acceptance checklist, evidence JSONs and executable probes.
